{"metadata":{"description":"Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - drive dsh agents from Zed, any ACP v1 client, or the built-in web UI over stdio / HTTP+SSE, with sessions, jobs, goals, skills and the agent tree on the wire","id":"gh:1336635197","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-acp","slug":"dushaobindoudou/dsh-acp","topics":["acp","agent","agent-client-protocol","coding-agent","cordis-plugin","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","zed"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) - drive dsh agents from Zed"},{"id":"p1s2","text":", any ACP v1 client, or the built-in web UI over stdio / HTTP+SSE, with sessions, jobs, goals, skill"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"s and the agent tree on the wire"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-acp-server"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server for the DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`).**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Drive a full dsh coding agent - streaming output, tool calls, permission prompts, durable sessions -"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" from Zed or any ACP v1 client, exactly like opencode or Gemini CLI."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"A `dsh` profile bundle that boots the entire DeepSeek Harness (agent loop, tools, sandbox, session p"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ersistence) with an ACP v1 JSON-RPC server instead of - or alongside - the web UI."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| ACP method | Status |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| `initialize` | ✅ full capability advertisement (`loadSession`, `promptCapabilities.image`, `sessio"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nCapabilities.list/resume/close/delete`) |
| `authenticate` | ✅ no-op success (dsh credentials live "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"outside ACP; empty `authMethods`) |
| `session/new` | ✅ durable dsh agent + modes + slash-command ad"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"vertisement + initial `configOptions` |
| `session/prompt` | ✅ streaming `agent_message_chunk` / `ag"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ent_thought_chunk` (reasoning), `plan` updates, full tool-call lifecycle, `{stopReason, usage}`; fai"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"led turns reject with a JSON-RPC error carrying the cause; **image blocks** persist through the dsh "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"attachments service; a single `/command` text block routes to the dsh command registry |
| `session/"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"set_config_option` | ✅ per-session `model` (`<provider>/<model>`) and `reasoning_effort` overrides; "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"live effect on the next step; unsupported knobs/values refuse with precise `-32602`; `config_option_"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"update` pushed on change |
| `usage_update` / `usage` | ✅ context usage (`used`/`size`) pushed from "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"token accounting; the prompt response sums the turn's tokens (experimental ACP field) |
| `session/l"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"ist` | ✅ every persisted + live session (id, cwd, title) |
| `session/resume` | ✅ reopen a persisted"},{"id":"p9s13","text":" session without replay (standard form of the vendor method) |
| `session/load` | ✅ reopen + replay "},{"id":"p9s14","text":"the transcript as `user_message_chunk` / `agent_message_chunk` |
| `session/set_mode` | ✅ `default` "},{"id":"p9s15","text":"⇄ `plan`, bridged to dsh plan mode, with `current_mode_update` push |
| `available_commands_update` "},{"id":"p9s16","text":"| ✅ the dsh command registry, advertised per session and refreshed each turn |
| `session/request_pe"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"rmission` | ✅ dsh's approval seam bridged to the client (allow once/always, reject once/always) |
| "},{"id":"p9s18","text":"`elicitation/create` | ✅ form-mode dsh user questions for clients declaring `elicitation.form`; one "},{"id":"p9s19","text":"single-select question falls back to permission buttons; richer questions fall through to the host's"},{"id":"p9s20","text":" answerer |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## The two final forms"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Form 1 — standalone (`dsh-acp-server`)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"After `npm i -g dsh-acp-server` (or via `npx`). The bin boots `dsh --profile acp` with the current s"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"tdio and passes every launcher flag through (`serve --port 7800`, `--patch extra.yml`). First use in"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" a DSH home auto-bootstraps the `acp` profile with the official `dsh plugin` command - bootstrap out"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"put goes to stderr, so an editor's stdout only ever sees ACP frames."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Zed → Settings → `agent_servers` (full sample in examples/zed-settings.json):"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Form 2 — together (`dsh web`)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install into the `web` profile once; every plain `dsh web` boot then serves the GUI and ACP on one p"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"all into the `web` profile once; every plain `dsh web` boot then serves the GUI and ACP on one port:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Prefer to keep `web` untouched? `node bin/setup-webacp.mjs --clone webacp` gives the same on `dsh --"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"web` untouched? `node bin/setup-webacp.mjs --clone webacp` gives the same on `dsh --profile webacp`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The script writes a row-level `inject: [agents, agentDefaultModel, webServer]` so Cordis starts the "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"acp-server fiber only after the shared `webServer` service exists - the stdio transport can never ra"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ce a web boot. A hand install without that row is safe too: the plugin web-mounts late via service p"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"rovisioning (terminal boots skip stdio entirely; daemon boots get an EOF grace window). The full row"},{"id":"p20s5","text":" is documented in examples/patches/web-mounted.yml."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Why a bin instead of the literal `dsh acp-server`: the dsh launcher hardcodes its app subcommands (`"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"web`, `plugin`) and parses argv before any plugin loads, so a bundle cannot register one; the wrappe"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"r is the same single-command shape."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Drive dsh from a script (`run`)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"`dsh-acp-server run` is a one-shot CLI for **external agents and orchestrators**: it spawns the real"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" `dsh --profile acp`, speaks ACP to it through the same SDK every other client uses, prints the answ"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"er, and exits. No ACP client implementation required:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Default output** is the final assistant answer as plain text on stdout; progress (tool calls, pe"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"rmission notes) goes to stderr. `--json` prints exactly one object: `{sessionId, stopReason, text, t"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"oolCalls: [{title, status}], usage?, error?}`.
- **Exit codes**: `0` done · `1` error · `2` timeout "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"(the turn was cancelled) · `3` cancelled · `4` a permission request was denied. A script branches on"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" the code, never on parsing prose.
- `--session <id>` resumes a persisted session (`dsh-acp-server r"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"un ... --session "$(cat last-session)"` keeps one conversation across invocations); without it each "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"run creates a fresh session.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Transport choice is deterministic at mount: `serve` subcommand → standalone HTTP server; a `webServe"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"r` service present (or arriving late) → routes registered on the shared server; otherwise stdio."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Source layout: `src/connection.ts` (method handlers) · `translate.ts` / `config-options.ts` (pure wi"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"re mappings, unit-tested) · `event-bridge.ts` / `perm-bridge.ts` (dsh ⇄ ACP seams) · `session-delete"},{"id":"p29s3","text":".ts` (guarded persisted-session cleanup) · `cli/run.ts` (the one-shot CLI; `cli/run-core.ts` is its "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"pure mapping layer) · `http-transport.ts` (shared HTTP router) · `serve-startup.ts` (the `serve` sub"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"command) · `config.ts` (schema) · `table.ts` (session registry)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Full research behind every mapping: `research/` - ACP protocol, DSH architecture, prior art, design "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"rch behind every mapping: `research/` - ACP protocol, DSH architecture, prior art, design blueprint."}],"truncated":true}
